definitions.short: Puah or Puvvah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H6312. Puah or Puvvah מֻּוָּה מּוּאָה, proper name, masculine in Issachar , Φουα , etc.; — מּוּאָה Judg 10:1 (see GFM), 1Chr 7:1 ; מֻּוָּה Gen 46:13 ; Num 26:3 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
